details:
Q1: What repository surface should be improved?
Choices:
A. Existing workflow or automation — provide its file/name and current problem (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation — provide the page/section and missing information
C. Another component — provide its path/name
Q2: What outcome should define success?
Choices:
A. Fix a defect — provide reproduction steps and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or change behavior — describe the current and desired behavior
C. Improve quality without behavior changes — specify measurable criteria
